newsitem.title: POLAND: STOMIL SEES '97 NET NO WORSE THAN '96.
newsitem.headline: STOMIL SEES '97 NET NO WORSE THAN '96.

text.p: Polish tyre maker Stomil Olsztyn SA, 52.1-percent owned by Michelin , should at least match last year's 52.7-million-zloty net profit despite recent news it needed to make a provision, the firm's head said.
"We think this year's profit will be no less than the 52.7 million zlotys achieved last year," Stomil president Jan Debek told daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki in its Wednesday issue.

Last week the firm said it would make a provision in June for the 13.6 million zlotys it would cost to recall two defective types of passenger car tyres and one type of delivery van tyre. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
